藏品名称_EN: Cloisonne flower and bird pattern tray
描述_EN: A tray has a flat, wide base with a "brim" around the edge. The pattern consists of flowers, birds and augers (jiao), with the spaces between them filled with whorls resembling the shape of the word "no". Nearly ten cloisonné trays similar in shape, size, pattern composition and technique to this work have been found in Japan and are thought to have been produced in China during the Ming Dynasty and sold in East Asia. These cloisonné mask trays were often used as candy containers in Japanese tea ceremonies.
描述_ZN: 一个托盘有一个平坦宽大的底座，边缘有一个 "帽檐"。 图案由花、鸟和蛟(蛟)组成，它们之间的空隙充满了类似于 "不 "字形状的轮纹。 在日本，已经发现了近10件在形状、尺寸、图案构成和技术上与这件作品相似的景泰蓝托盘，人们认为它们是在明代中国生产并在东亚地区销售的。 这些景泰蓝面具托盘在日本的茶道中经常被用作糖果容器。
